proof_body:
by
  intro a L r h0 h1 hc
  have hb : ∀ n, |a n - L| ≤ r ^ n * |a 0 - L| := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      calc |a (m + 1) - L| ≤ r * |a m - L| := hc m
        _ ≤ r * (r ^ m * |a 0 - L|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih h0
        _ = r ^ (m + 1) * |a 0 - L| := by ring
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r ^ n * |a 0 - L|) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one h0 h1).mul_const |a 0 - L|
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb n) hlim
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r < 1 → (∀ n, |a (n + 1) - L| ≤ r * |a n - L|) → Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds L)
